question.text: How many principles are there under the UN Global Compact (UNGC), and across which four areas are they organised?

answer.text: 9 principles across Human Rights, Labour, Environment, Governance
10 principles across Human Rights, Labour, Environment, Anti-Corruption
12 principles across ESG, SDG, Human Rights, Labour

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 6.1, UNGC has 10 principles grouped across four areas: Human Rights (P1-P2), Labour (P3-P6), Environment (P7-P9) and Anti-Corruption (P10). UNGC derives its principles from the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, ILO Declaration, Rio Declaration, and UN Convention against Corruption. The Trap: 9 is the NGRBC principle count in India (often confused). 12 or 7 are fabricated. Only 10/HR-Labour-Env-Anti-Corruption is accurate for UNGC. Cross-Exam Context: V-A Distributor and V-B MF Foundation reference UNGC as a global ethics framework. XXIII expects exact memorisation of 10 principles across 4 pillars.
